example: We flew to America last spring to visit our cousins.
example_translation: 去年春天，我们飞往美国探望表亲。
note: 本句选美国义；该名称也可泛指美洲

example: She found a handwritten note among the old photographs.
example_translation: 她在那些旧照片中发现了一张手写便条。
note: 表示处于一组人或事物之中

example: A small amount of water remained in the bottle.
example_translation: 瓶子里还剩少量水。
note: an amount of 后接不可数名词

example: The puppet show will amuse younger children.
example_translation: 这场木偶戏会逗乐年幼的孩子。
note: amuse sb；不要与 amazed 混用

example: An ancestor of hers built this stone house.
example_translation: 她的一位祖先建造了这座石屋。
note: 可数名词；本例指家族先人

example: The ancient wall still surrounds the village.
example_translation: 那道古老的城墙仍环绕着村庄。
note: 描述年代久远的事物

example: Bring a notebook and a pencil to the workshop.
example_translation: 带一本笔记本和一支铅笔来参加工作坊。
note: 列强读 /ænd/；连贯语流中常弱读

example: She expressed her anger without raising her voice.
example_translation: 她没有提高嗓门，就表达了自己的愤怒。
note: 本批为情绪名词，不是动词

example: Draw an angle of ninety degrees in your notebook.
example_translation: 在笔记本上画一个九十度的角。
note: 本例为几何中的角

example: He was angry about the broken promise.
example_translation: 他因对方没有兑现承诺而生气。
note: be angry about sth 表示生气的原因

example: Every animal in the shelter needs food and clean water.
example_translation: 收容所里的每只动物都需要食物和干净的水。
note: 可数名词；不将动物等同于宠物

example: Mud covered his boot up to the ankle.
example_translation: 泥巴没过了他的靴子，一直到了脚踝处。
note: 区别于脚 foot 和膝盖 knee

example: They planted a tree on their tenth wedding anniversary.
example_translation: 他们在结婚十周年纪念日种下了一棵树。
note: 本例为 wedding anniversary

example: The school will announce the results on Monday.
example_translation: 学校将在星期一公布结果。
note: announce 后直接接要公布的内容

example: Constant noise can annoy people who are trying to read.
example_translation: 持续的噪声会使正在努力阅读的人感到烦恼。
note: 人感到烦恼用 annoyed；本词是动词

example: Our annual school festival takes place in May.
example_translation: 我们一年一度的校园节在五月举行。
note: 修饰定期每年举行的活动

example: I need another sheet of paper to finish the drawing.
example_translation: 我还需要一张纸才能完成这幅画。
note: 本批为限定词，后接单数可数名词

example: There is more than one possible answer to this question.
example_translation: 这个问题不止有一个可能的答案。
note: the answer to a question；本批为名词

example: An ant carried a crumb along the path.
example_translation: 一只蚂蚁沿着小路搬运一块食物碎屑。
note: 不要与 aunt 的英式读音混淆

example: We anticipate heavy traffic on Friday afternoon.
example_translation: 我们预计星期五下午交通会很拥堵。
note: 可直接接名词或从句

meaning: 古董的；古老且有收藏价值的
example: The antique clock still works after a hundred years.
example_translation: 那座古董钟经过一百年后仍能运转。
note: 本批为形容词，修饰 clock

example: Her anxiety eased after she heard the good news.
example_translation: 听到那个好消息后，她的担忧减轻了。
note: 本批为情绪名词

example: He felt anxious before his first speech.
example_translation: 第一次演讲前，他感到焦虑。
note: 本批选担忧义，不是渴望义

meaning: 一些；一点（用于否定句等）
example: I wanted some tea, but there wasn't any.
example_translation: 我想喝点茶，可是一点也没有。
note: 本例的 any 独立使用，代指茶

example: The path was muddy, but we continued anyhow.
example_translation: 小路泥泞，但我们还是继续前进了。
note: 本例表示尽管有困难仍继续

example: Is there anything I can do to help?
example_translation: 有什么我能做的事可以帮上忙吗？
note: 用于疑问句，表示任何可以提供帮助的事情

example: It might rain, but we are going anyway.
example_translation: 可能会下雨，但我们还是要去。
note: 本例强调不受前述情况影响

example: I cannot find my keys anywhere.
example_translation: 我哪里都找不到钥匙。
note: 在否定句中表示任何地方

example: Keep the two chairs a metre apart.
example_translation: 让这两把椅子相隔一米。
note: 表示两者之间的距离

example: They rented a small apartment near the station.
example_translation: 他们在车站附近租了一套小公寓。
note: 指住宅中的一套房，不是整栋楼

example: Apparently, the old bridge will reopen next month.
example_translation: 据说，那座旧桥将在下个月重新开放。
note: 表示根据听说或已知信息判断，并非 certainly

example: The charity made an appeal for warm clothes.
example_translation: 那家慈善机构发出了募集御寒衣物的呼吁。
note: an appeal for sth；本批为名词

example: A rainbow may appear after the rain stops.
example_translation: 雨停后可能会出现彩虹。
note: 本批为出现义，不是似乎义

example: The long walk gave us a healthy appetite.
example_translation: 长途步行让我们胃口大开。
note: 本批为想进食的胃口

example: The audience began to applaud as the dancers returned.
example_translation: 舞者返场时，观众开始鼓掌。
note: 本批为鼓掌义，不是赞成某种意见

example: She cut an apple into slices for the picnic.
example_translation: 她把一个苹果切成片，准备野餐时吃。
note: 单数前可用 an

example: Each applicant will receive a reply next week.
example_translation: 每位申请人都将在下周收到回复。
note: 指提出申请的人，不是申请材料

example: Please send your application before the end of June.
example_translation: 请在六月底之前寄出申请材料。
note: 本批选申请义，不是应用程序义

example: She plans to apply for a place on the course.
example_translation: 她打算申请一个课程名额。
note: apply for sth；区别于 apply a method 的应用义

example: I have an appointment with my tutor at ten.
example_translation: 我约好十点与导师见面。
note: an appointment with sb

example: I appreciate the time you spent helping me.
example_translation: 我很感激你花时间帮助我。
note: appreciate 后接事物或行为，不能直接等同 thank sb

example: We slowed down as we began to approach the village.
example_translation: 开始接近村庄时，我们放慢了速度。
note: 动词直接接地点，不另加 to

example: Wear shoes that are appropriate for a long walk.
example_translation: 穿适合长距离步行的鞋子。
note: 形容词词尾 /iət/；动词读音不同

example: The council must approve the plan before work begins.
example_translation: 工程开始前，议会必须批准该计划。
note: 本例为直接批准某事，不是 approve of 的赞成义

example: We walked through a stone arch into the courtyard.
example_translation: 我们穿过一道石拱门，走进庭院。
note: 本批为名词

example: The architect designed a library with large windows.
example_translation: 那位建筑师设计了一座有大窗户的图书馆。
note: 人与建筑学 architecture 不同

example: Arctic winds brought snow to the northern coast.
example_translation: 来自北极的风把雪带到了北部海岸。
note: 形容词通常保留大写开头

example: This area is famous for its quiet lakes.
example_translation: 这一地区以宁静的湖泊闻名。
note: 本批选区域义，不是面积数值

example: They began to argue about the best route home.
example_translation: 他们开始争论哪条回家路线最好。
note: argue about sth 表示就某事争论

example: New questions often arise during a group discussion.
example_translation: 小组讨论中常常会出现新的问题。
note: 不及物动词；arise、arose、arisen，不与 raise 混用

example: She carried the basket under one arm.
example_translation: 她把篮子夹在一条胳膊下面。
note: 本批为身体部位，不是武器义

example: The army built a temporary bridge across the river.
example_translation: 军队在河上修建了一座临时桥。
note: 本批为军事组织

example: They built a fence around the garden.
example_translation: 他们在花园周围建了一道围栏。
note: 本批为介词，后接 garden

example: The seating arrangement allows everyone to see the screen.
example_translation: 座位的安排让每个人都能看见屏幕。
note: 本例为 seating arrangement

example: The police moved to arrest the suspect near the station.
example_translation: 警方前往车站附近逮捕那名嫌疑人。
note: 本批为动词，不是名词 arrest

example: We hope to arrive before the museum opens.
example_translation: 我们希望在博物馆开门前到达。
note: arrive 为不及物动词；地点通常用 at 或 in 引出

example: Follow the blue arrow to reach the main entrance.
example_translation: 沿着蓝色箭头所指的方向走，就能到达正门。
note: 本批为指示方向的箭头，不是射出的箭

example: The museum shows art from different parts of the world.
example_translation: 博物馆展示来自世界不同地区的艺术作品。
note: 本例中 art 作不可数名词

example: She wrote an article about the history of the town.
example_translation: 她写了一篇关于这座小镇历史的文章。
note: 本批为文章义，不是冠词义

example: The plants grew under artificial light in the laboratory.
example_translation: 这些植物在实验室的人造光照下生长。
note: 区别于 natural

example: The artist used old newspapers to create a portrait.
example_translation: 那位艺术家用旧报纸创作了一幅肖像。
note: 本例中的 artist 指创作者

example: She works as a guide during the summer.
example_translation: 她夏天担任导游。
note: 本批为介词；列强读 /æz/，句中常弱读

example: He felt ashamed of the unkind words he had used.
example_translation: 他为自己说过的刻薄话感到羞愧。
note: be ashamed of sth

example: The exhibition includes maps of Asia from different centuries.
example_translation: 展览包括不同世纪绘制的亚洲地图。
note: 地名开头大写；本批保留词典所列首个英式读音

example: Please step aside so the cart can pass.
example_translation: 请往旁边站一点，让小车通过。
note: 本批为位置副词

example: You can ask the guide about the old tower.
example_translation: 你可以向导游询问那座古塔的情况。
note: ask sb about sth

example: The baby was asleep when we reached the house.
example_translation: 我们到家时，婴儿已经睡着了。
note: 常用于 be asleep 或 fall asleep

example: We discussed every aspect of the project before starting.
example_translation: 开始之前，我们讨论了这个项目的各个方面。
note: an aspect of sth

example: The teacher will assess our speaking skills tomorrow.
example_translation: 老师明天将评估我们的口语能力。
note: 本例为评估能力，不限于财产估价

example: The teacher will assign a different task to each group.
example_translation: 老师将给每个小组分配不同的任务。
note: assign sth to sb

example: The assistant prepared the materials for the experiment.
example_translation: 助手准备好了实验所需的材料。
note: 本批为人员名词

example: Our local gardening association meets every month.
example_translation: 我们当地的园艺协会每月聚会一次。
note: 本批为组织义，不是联想义

example: Do not assume that every quiet student is shy.
example_translation: 不要认为每个安静的学生都很害羞。
note: assume that；所认为的内容未必已有证明

example: The plan rests on the assumption that the road will reopen.
example_translation: 这个计划建立在道路将重新开放的假设之上。
note: the assumption that；本批为名词

example: The scale of the ancient building may astonish visitors.
example_translation: 那座古建筑的规模可能会让游客惊讶。
note: astonish sb；人的感受可用 astonished

example: The astronaut practised moving in a heavy spacesuit.
example_translation: 那位宇航员练习穿着沉重的宇航服活动。
note: 区别于 astronomer 天文学家

example: An astronomer explained how the telescope collects light.
example_translation: 一位天文学家解释了望远镜如何收集光线。
note: 不是乘航天器旅行的 astronaut

example: The workshop begins at nine in the morning.
example_translation: 工作坊在上午九点开始。
note: 具体时刻用 at；列强读 /æt/，句中常弱读

example: Each athlete must wear a number during the race.
example_translation: 每位运动员比赛时都必须佩戴号码。
note: 可数名词

example: The Atlantic coast is known for its powerful waves.
example_translation: 大西洋沿岸以强劲的海浪闻名。
note: 本批为形容词；海洋名称通常用 the Atlantic

example: Soft lighting created a welcoming atmosphere in the café.
example_translation: 柔和的灯光让咖啡馆里有一种亲切的氛围。
note: 本批选气氛义，不是大气层义

example: Please attach the photo to your message.
example_translation: 请把照片附在你的消息中。
note: attach sth to sth

example: The castle survived an attack from the sea.
example_translation: 那座城堡挺过了一次来自海上的袭击。
note: 本批为名词

example: The team worked hard to attain its goal.
example_translation: 团队努力工作，以实现目标。
note: 直接接目标；语体较正式

example: Her first attempt to solve the puzzle failed.
example_translation: 她第一次尝试解开谜题时失败了。
note: an attempt to do sth；本批为名词

example: More than fifty people will attend the meeting.
example_translation: 五十多人将出席会议。
note: attend the meeting，不另加 at

example: Please pay attention to the changes in the diagram.
example_translation: 请注意图表中的变化。
note: pay attention to sth

example: Her positive attitude helped the team through a difficult week.
example_translation: 她积极的态度帮助团队度过了艰难的一周。
note: 本批为对事物的态度

example: The bright flowers attract visitors to the garden.
example_translation: 鲜艳的花朵吸引游客来到花园。
note: attract sb to a place

example: The audience waited quietly for the concert to begin.
example_translation: 观众安静地等待音乐会开始。
note: 本批为观看或聆听表演的人群

example: My aunt lives nearby and often visits us.
example_translation: 我的姨妈住在附近，经常来看我们。
note: 英语 aunt 可对应多种中文亲属称谓

example: The author spent a year researching the book.
example_translation: 那位作者花了一年时间为这本书做研究。
note: 本批为写作者

example: The manager has the authority to change the schedule.
example_translation: 经理有权更改日程。
note: 本批为职权义，不是 authorities 当局

example: The automatic doors opened as we approached.
example_translation: 我们走近时，自动门打开了。
note: 本批描述无需手动操作的设备

example: The robot can make autonomous decisions in unfamiliar places.
example_translation: 这个机器人能在陌生地方自主作出决定。
note: 本例为自主决策；也可用于地区自治

example: The leaves turn golden in autumn.
example_translation: 树叶在秋天变成金黄色。
note: 季节前通常用 in；此处不自动把 fall 当作拼写变体

example: Free maps are available at the information desk.
example_translation: 咨询台提供免费地图。
note: 本句指能够取得，不是有空的人

example: The average of four and six is five.
example_translation: 四和六的平均数是五。
note: 本批为名词，不是普通的这一形容词义

example: Leave early to avoid getting caught in traffic.
example_translation: 早点出发，以免遇上交通拥堵。
note: avoid 后接名词或动名词，不接 to do

example: The children were still awake at midnight.
example_translation: 午夜时，孩子们还醒着。
note: 本批为形容词，常用于系动词之后

example: My sister and I planted flowers beside the gate.
example_translation: 我和姐姐在大门旁种了花。
note: 作主语；正式书写始终大写，不将 me 当作拼写变体
